verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a work-tracking product, so subtasks and blocking dependencies are a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions subtasks, task checklists, story links or blocker relationships. It covers only the REST API, Epics, Iterations, Roadmaps, automations and integrations, none of which shows breaking work into subtasks or linking dependent tasks.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can break work into subtasks and link dependent tasks so blocking order is clear
